Differential Calculus — Implicit Differentiation

Chapter 2: General Second-Degree Implicit Equation | Page 34

Worked Problem 01
Problem Statement Implicit Differentiation & Product Rule
Find dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​ from the given implicit algebraic relation:
ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0ax^2 + 2hxy + by^2 + d = 0ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত দ্বিঘাত অব্যক্ত সমীকরণটি উল্লেখ করি (Given Implicit Second-Degree Equation)
ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0ax^2 + 2hxy + by^2 + d = 0ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0
STEP 2 উভয়পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ অপারেটর প্রয়োগ করি (Applying Differentiation Operator w.r.t. x)
ddx(ax2)+ddx(2hxy)+ddx(by2)+ddx(d)=0\frac{d}{dx}(ax^2) + \frac{d}{dx}(2hxy) + \frac{d}{dx}(by^2) + \frac{d}{dx}(d) = 0dxd​(ax2)+dxd​(2hxy)+dxd​(by2)+dxd​(d)=0
STEP 3 গুণন বিধি ও চেইন রুল প্রয়োগ করে প্রতিটি পদের অন্তরজ নির্ণয় করি (Applying Product Rule to xyxyxy & Chain Rule to y2y^2y2)
a(2x)+2h(xdydx+y⋅1)+b(2ydydx)+0=0a(2x) + 2h\left( x\frac{dy}{dx} + y\cdot 1 \right) + b\left( 2y\frac{dy}{dx} \right) + 0 = 0a(2x)+2h(xdxdy​+y⋅1)+b(2ydxdy​)+0=0 2ax+2hxdydx+2hy+2bydydx=02ax + 2hx\frac{dy}{dx} + 2hy + 2by\frac{dy}{dx} = 02ax+2hxdxdy​+2hy+2bydxdy​=0
STEP 4 উভয়পক্ষকে ২ দ্বারা ভাগ করে dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​ পদগুলো একপাশে সাজাই (Dividing by 2 & Grouping dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​ Terms)
(hx+by)dydx+(ax+hy)=0  ⟹  (hx+by)dydx=−(ax+hy)(hx + by)\frac{dy}{dx} + (ax + hy) = 0 \implies (hx + by)\frac{dy}{dx} = -(ax + hy)(hx+by)dxdy​+(ax+hy)=0⟹(hx+by)dxdy​=−(ax+hy)
STEP 5 dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​-এর জন্য সমাধান করে চূড়ান্ত অন্তরজ পাই (Solving for Explicit Derivative dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​)
dydx=−ax+hyhx+by\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{ax + hy}{hx + by}dxdy​=−hx+byax+hy​
FINAL ANSWER dydx=−ax+hyhx+by\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{ax + hy}{hx + by}dxdy​=−hx+byax+hy​

Technical Notes
📘 Box 1: Mathematical Foundations & Formula Reference
  • Implicit Differentiation Principle: Differentiating both sides with respect to xxx, treating yyy as an implicit function of xxx (y=y(x)y = y(x)y=y(x)).
  • Product Rule on Cross Term: ddx(xy)=xdydx+y\frac{d}{dx}(xy) = x\frac{dy}{dx} + ydxd​(xy)=xdxdy​+y.
  • Chain Rule on Powers of yyy: ddx(yn)=nyn−1dydx\frac{d}{dx}(y^n) = n y^{n-1} \frac{dy}{dx}dxd​(yn)=nyn−1dxdy​.
  • Constant Derivative: ddx(d)=0\frac{d}{dx}(d) = 0dxd​(d)=0.
⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Treating yyy as a Constant: Writing ddx(2hxy)=2hy\frac{d}{dx}(2hxy) = 2hydxd​(2hxy)=2hy instead of using the product rule 2h(xy′+y)2h(x y' + y)2h(xy′+y).
  • Dropping dydx\frac{dy}{dx}dxdy​ on y2y^2y2: Writing ddx(by2)=2by\frac{d}{dx}(by^2) = 2bydxd​(by2)=2by instead of 2bydydx2by\frac{dy}{dx}2bydxdy​.
  • Forgetting the Minus Sign on Transposition: When moving (ax+hy)(ax + hy)(ax+hy) to the RHS, it becomes −(ax+hy)-(ax + hy)−(ax+hy).
💡 Box 3: Partial Derivative Formula Shortcut (dydx=−FxFy\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{F_x}{F_y}dxdy​=−Fy​Fx​​)
  • For any implicit function F(x,y)=ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0F(x, y) = ax^2 + 2hxy + by^2 + d = 0F(x,y)=ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0: Fx=∂F∂x=2ax+2hyF_x = \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = 2ax + 2hyFx​=∂x∂F​=2ax+2hy Fy=∂F∂y=2hx+2byF_y = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y} = 2hx + 2byFy​=∂y∂F​=2hx+2by
  • Applying Euler's Implicit Function Theorem: dydx=−∂F∂x∂F∂y=−2ax+2hy2hx+2by=−ax+hyhx+by\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}}{\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}} = -\frac{2ax + 2hy}{2hx + 2by} = -\frac{ax + hy}{hx + by}dxdy​=−∂y∂F​∂x∂F​​=−2hx+2by2ax+2hy​=−hx+byax+hy​
  • This verifies the step-by-step solution instantly!
🌐 Box 4: Geometric & Conic Sections Interpretation
  • Conic Curve Tangents: The equation ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0ax^2 + 2hxy + by^2 + d = 0ax2+2hxy+by2+d=0 represents a central conic (ellipse, hyperbola, or pair of lines).
  • Slope of Tangent: At any point (x1,y1)(x_1, y_1)(x1​,y1​) on the curve, the slope is m=−ax1+hy1hx1+by1m = -\frac{ax_1 + hy_1}{hx_1 + by_1}m=−hx1​+by1​ax1​+hy1​​.
  • Equation of Tangent: Yields the standard conic tangent axx1+h(xy1+yx1)+byy1+d=0ax x_1 + h(x y_1 + y x_1) + by y_1 + d = 0axx1​+h(xy1​+yx1​)+byy1​+d=0.
